findings.F1: The supporting check could not run because the forecast is saturated: 88 % of the 4,229 short bets sit at the -20 cap (median |forecast| 20, 25th percentile 20), so the split above the median left 0 cases in the larger half and 4,087 in the smaller. The idea's grading was therefore never tested, although the main measure was on the predicted side (+0.38 % per case, t 2.67).
findings.F2: The idea's own grade, the narrowness of the two-day stretch against the 30-day average four-hour range, is strongly graded on these cases. The mean unusual 18-bar move rises by quartile of narrowness from -0.41 % (t -1.2) to -0.13 %, +0.53 % (t 2.0) and +1.67 % (t 6.0, strength 0.166, 770 cases). Its Spearman correlation with the move is 0.096.
findings.F3: The tested forecast did not separate cases, for two reasons.
findings.F4: The effect builds beyond the plan's three days. Over all cases the unusual move is +0.14 % over 1 day, +0.35 % over 2, +0.38 % over 3 and +0.67 % over 6 (t 3.4). In the narrowest quartile it reaches +2.77 % over 6 days (t 6.6, 733 cases), against +1.67 % over 3.
findings.F5: The narrowest quartile holds across periods and coins: its mean unusual 3-day move is positive in all 8 years (from +0.10 % in 2019 to +2.99 % in 2024) and in 17 of 19 coins.
findings.F6: The narrowest quartile also holds in the steepest falling months. In the deeper half of 30-day falls it gives +1.98 % (t 4.8), while the wider stretches there give -1.19 % (t -2.2) and -1.00 % (t -2.0) in the two widest quartiles. Over all cases, the most negative quartile of 30-day returns gives -1.20 % (t -3.3). Wide breaks in steep falls are where the pooled result is drowned.
findings.F7: Measured against the cost of a trade (0.22 %, F1 in the findings above), the pooled idea cannot pay but its narrow cases can.

ideas.idea: When a four-hour bar closes below the lowest low of a coin's preceding two-day narrow stretch, the coin falls over the next six days, and the narrower that stretch was compared with the coin's 30-day average four-hour range, the larger the fall, only while the coin's 30-day return is negative.
ideas.consequence: Short a downward break out of a narrow two-day range in a coin that has fallen over the past month, hold it about six days, size it by how narrow the stretch was, and do not size it by how far the close broke below the range.
ideas.name: narrow breakdown six days
